facts.title: Arab Spring — Tunisia origin
facts.text: The Arab Spring began in Tunisia in December 2010, when a young vendor named Mohammed Bouazizi set himself on fire.

facts.title: Cuba — post-revolutionary 1959 context
facts.text: Fidel Castro had assumed power in Cuba by 1959, during the post-revolutionary period.

facts.title: Chinese Cultural Revolution
facts.text: The Cultural Revolution took place in China from 1966 to 1976 and was a political movement initiated by Mao Zedong.

facts.title: Hundred Years’ War
facts.text: The Hundred Years’ War (1337–1453) was a prolonged struggle between the rival kingdoms of England and France.

facts.title: Crimean War
facts.text: The Crimean War ran from 1853 to 1856.

facts.title: Treaty of Shimonoseki
facts.text: The 1895 Treaty of Shimonoseki was a treaty of peace between China and Japan that recognized Korea’s independence and autonomy and provided for specified territorial cessions by China to Japan.

facts.title: First Anglo-Burmese War
facts.text: The First Anglo-Burmese War lasted from 1824 to 1826 and ended in February 1826 with the Treaty of Yandabo.

facts.title: United States Civil War
facts.text: The United States Civil War ran from 1861 to 1865.
